extracted_text.text: 育児・産休・介護休業規程制定日：2024年4月1日　改訂日：2025年10月1日　人事部第1条（目的）本規程は、育児・介護休業法に基づき、従業員が育児または家族の介護を行うために休業を取得できる制度を定めることを目的とする。第2条（産前産後休業）産前：出産予定日の8週間前（多胎妊娠の場合は14週間前）から取得可能。産後：出産日の翌日から8週間（本人の希望があり医師が認めた場合は6週間後から就業可）。第3条（育児休業）対象：1歳未満の子を養育する従業員（パパ育休制度により父親も取得可）。期間：原則として子が1歳になるまで。保育所入所待機等の場合は最長2歳まで延長可。分割取得：2回まで分割取得が可能（2022年10月改正育介法対応）。第4条（申請手続き）・休業開始予定日の1ヶ月前（産後パパ育休は2週間前）までに「育児休業取得申請書」を人事部へ提出。・休業期間中の社会保険料免除手続きは人事部が代行する。・給付金（育児休業給付金）は従業員本人がハローワークへ申請すること。第5条（介護休業）対象：要介護状態にある家族を介護する従業員。期間：同一対象家族につき通算93日（3回まで分割可）。介護休暇：年5日（対象家族が2人以上の場合は年10日）。第6条（子の看護休暇）小学校就学前の子1人につき年5日、2人以上は年10日。1時間単位での取得が可能（時間単位取得：2021年1月施行）。第7条（社会保険・給付）育児休業中は健康保険・厚生年金の保険料が免除される（免除期間も被保険者期間に算入）。雇用保険から育児休業給付金が支給される（休業開始時賃金の67%、181日以降は50%）。承認フロー1. 従業員 → 申請書提出 → 人事部受付2. 人事部 → 上長確認 → 承認3. 人事部 → 社会保険事務所への届出4. 人事部 → 従業員へ承認通知（システム登録）以上　本規程に関するお問い合わせは人事部（内線：3001）まで。産前産後休暇申請を受理。期間: 2026-08-05 〜 2027-06-08。HW-2026-283と照合済。承認完了。産前産後休暇申請を受理。期間: 2026-08-05 〜 2027-06-08。HW-2026-283と照合済。承認完了。----------------------------------------傷病休暇申請を受理。期間: 2026-08-05 〜 2026-12-18。HW-2026-705と照合済。承認完了。

#Requires -Version 5.1<#.SYNOPSIS    Launch Theme M1 -- Mixed Multi-Domain Orchestrator    Asks for config first, then starts portals + desktop apps, then runs orchestrator..USAGE    cd <this-folder>    .\launch_m1.ps1.ENV OVERRIDES    Set before running to skip prompts:    $env:M1_SEED  = "42"    $env:M1_SPEED = "1"    # 1=fast(0.4x), 2=normal(1.4x)    $env:M1_SCALE = "1"    # 1=small(5-7), 2=medium(8-10), 3=large(11-14)    $env:M1_DATE  = "2026-06-29"#>Set-StrictMode -Off$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"# -- Paths ----------------------------------------------------------------$ScriptDir  = Split-Path -Parent $MyInvocation.MyCommand.Path$ToolsDir   = Join-Path $ScriptDir "tools"$ScriptsDir = Join-Path $ScriptDir "scripts"$DocsDir    = Join-Path $ScriptDir "documents"$TmpDir     = Join-Path (Split-Path $ScriptDir -Parent) "chrome-profiles"# -- Find executables -----------------------------------------------------function Find-Exe {    param([string[]]$Candidates, [string]$Name)    foreach ($c in $Candidates) {        if (Test-Path $c) { return $c }    }    $cmd = Get-Command $Name -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue    if ($cmd) { return $cmd.Source }    return $null}$PythonExe = Find-Exe @(    "C:\WINDOWS\py.exe",    "C:\Python314\python.exe",    "C:\Python312\python.exe",    "C:\Python311\python.exe",    "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Programs\Python\Python312\python.exe") "python"$ChromeExe = Find-Exe @(    "C:\Program Files\Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe",    "C:\Program Files (x86)\Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe") "chrome"$ExcelExe = Find-Exe @(    "C:\Program Files\Microsoft Office\root\Office16\EXCEL.EXE",    "C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft Office\root\Office16\EXCEL.EXE") "EXCEL"# -- Quick validation before prompting ------------------------------------if (-not $PythonExe) { Write-Error "Python not found."; exit 1 }if (-not $ChromeExe) { Write-Error "Chrome not found."; exit 1 }# ============================================================================# 1. USER INPUT  (prompt first, before any windows)# ============================================================================Write-Host ""Write-Host ("=" * 60)Write-Host "  Theme M1 - Run Setup"Write-Host ("=" * 60)# Seed — generate random if blank so orchestrator never re-promptsif (-not $env:M1_SEED) {    Write-Host "  [1] Seed - integer, blank for random" -NoNewline    $raw = Read-Host    if ($raw) { $env:M1_SEED = $raw } else { $env:M1_SEED = Get-Random -Min 100000 -Max 999999 }}Write-Host "  [1] Seed: $env:M1_SEED"# Speedif (-not $env:M1_SPEED) {    Write-Host "  [2] Speed - 1=fast 0.4x  2=normal 1.4x  [2]" -NoNewline    $raw = Read-Host    if ($raw) { $env:M1_SPEED = $raw } else { $env:M1_SPEED = "2" }}Write-Host "  [2] Speed: $env:M1_SPEED"# Scaleif (-not $env:M1_SCALE) {    Write-Host "  [3] Scale - 1=small 5-7  2=medium 8-10  3=large 11-14  [2]" -NoNewline    $raw = Read-Host    if ($raw) { $env:M1_SCALE = $raw } else { $env:M1_SCALE = "2" }}Write-Host "  [3] Scale: $env:M1_SCALE"# Dateif (-not $env:M1_DATE) {    Write-Host "  [4] Run date YYYY-MM-DD, blank=today" -NoNewline    $raw = Read-Host    if ($raw) { $env:M1_DATE = $raw } else { $env:M1_DATE = (Get-Date -Format "yyyy-MM-dd") }}Write-Host "  [4] Date: $env:M1_DATE"$env:PYTHONUTF8 = "1"Write-Host ""Write-Host "  Starting in 5 seconds. Press Ctrl-C to abort."Start-Sleep -Seconds 5# ============================================================================# 2. Infrastructure setup# ============================================================================Write-Host ""Write-Host "  Theme M1 - Launch Checklist"Write-Host "  -------------------------------------------------------"Write-Host "  Python : $PythonExe"Write-Host "  Chrome : $ChromeExe"& $PythonExe -c "import pyautogui, websocket" 2>&1 | Out-Nullif ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {    Write-Warning "Some packages missing. Run: pip install pyautogui websocket-client"} else {    Write-Host "  packages OK"}# -- GT log dir -----------------------------------------------------------$GtLogDir = Join-Path (Split-Path $ScriptDir -Parent) "gt-logs"New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $GtLogDir | Out-Null$RunId = "theme_m1_$(Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss')"Write-Host "  GT log : $GtLogDir\$RunId.jsonl"if (-not (Test-Path $DocsDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $DocsDir | Out-Null }$PdfCount = (Get-ChildItem $DocsDir -Filter "*.pdf" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Measure-Object).CountWrite-Host "  Docs   : $DocsDir ($PdfCount PDFs)"New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $TmpDir | Out-Null# -- Kill lingering http.server on our ports ------------------------------foreach ($port in @(5122, 5123, 5124)) {    $pids_raw = netstat -ano 2>$null | Select-String ":$port\s"    foreach ($line in $pids_raw) {        $p = ($line -split "\s+")[-1]        if ($p -match "^\d+$") {            try { Stop-Process -Id ([int]$p) -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } catch {}        }    }}# -- Launch everything in parallel -----------------------------------------$launch_ops = @()# http.server for each portalWrite-Host "  Starting Python http.server on ports 5122/5123/5124..."$server_defs = @(    @{port=5122; dir="hr-portal-jp"},    @{port=5123; dir="finance-portal-jp"},    @{port=5124; dir="ops-portal-jp"})foreach ($entry in $server_defs) {    $d = Join-Path $ToolsDir $entry.dir    $launch_ops += @{exe=$PythonExe; args=@("-m", "http.server", "$($entry.port)", "--directory", $d); label="http.server :$($entry.port)"; hidden=$true}}# Notepad$launch_ops += @{exe="notepad.exe"; args=@(); label="Notepad"}# Excelif ($ExcelExe -and (Test-Path $ExcelExe)) {    $xlsRef = Join-Path $ScriptDir "documents\m1_reference.xlsx"    if (Test-Path $xlsRef) {        $launch_ops += @{exe=$ExcelExe; args=@("`"$xlsRef`""); label="Excel (m1_reference.xlsx)"}    } else {        $launch_ops += @{exe=$ExcelExe; args=@(); label="Excel"}    }} else {    Write-Warning "  Excel not found - lookup steps will be skipped"}# Browser extension — loaded into scripted Chrome so browser_* / URL / DOM events# appear in raw UIA stream. Override with $env:M1_EXT_PATH if needed.$ExtPath = if ($env:M1_EXT_PATH) { $env:M1_EXT_PATH } else {    Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE "Downloads\procmine-extension-v1.0.0 (1)\procmine-extension"}if (Test-Path $ExtPath) {    Write-Host "  Browser extension: $ExtPath"    Write-Host "  -> browser_url_change / DOM events WILL appear in raw stream"} else {    Write-Warning "  Browser extension not found at: $ExtPath"    Write-Warning "  Set M1_EXT_PATH to override. Raw stream will lack URL route context."    $ExtPath = $null}# 3 Chrome portal windows$portals = @(    @{url="http://127.0.0.1:5122/"; cdp=9222; label="HR Portal";      dir="m1-hr"},    @{url="http://127.0.0.1:5123/"; cdp=9223; label="Finance Portal";  dir="m1-finance"},    @{url="http://127.0.0.1:5124/"; cdp=9224; label="Ops Portal";      dir="m1-ops"})foreach ($p in $portals) {    $udd = Join-Path $TmpDir $p.dir    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $udd | Out-Null    $chromeArgs = @(        "--remote-debugging-port=$($p.cdp)",        "--user-data-dir=$udd",        "--no-first-run",        "--no-default-browser-check",        "--disable-features=TranslateUI",        "--remote-allow-origins=*",        "--window-size=1280,900",        "--new-window",        $p.url    )    if ($ExtPath) { $chromeArgs += "--load-extension=$ExtPath" }    $launch_ops += @{exe=$ChromeExe; args=$chromeArgs; label="Chrome $($p.label)"}}# Fire everything in parallel; keep handles for cleanup$launched_procs = @()foreach ($op in $launch_ops) {    Write-Host "    Launching $($op.label)..."    $spArgs = @{FilePath=$op.exe; PassThru=$true}    if ($op.args.Count -gt 0) { $spArgs.ArgumentList = $op.args }    if ($op.hidden) { $spArgs.WindowStyle = "Hidden" }    $proc = Start-Process @spArgs    if ($proc) { $launched_procs += $proc }}Write-Host "  Waiting for all windows and portals to load..."Start-Sleep -Seconds 8# -- Extension check -------------------------------------------------------# Load Unpacked extensions are stored in Secure Preferences (not Extensions folder)$ExtId = "gfnbggcmaifligdcdiafmlbgpogheenn"$ExtInstalled = $falseforeach ($dir in @("m1-hr", "m1-finance", "m1-ops")) {    $secPref = Join-Path $TmpDir "$dir\Default\Secure Preferences"    if (Test-Path $secPref) {        $txt = Get-Content $secPref -Raw        if ($txt -match $ExtId) { $ExtInstalled = $true; break }    }}$NmhRunning = $null -ne (Get-Process procmine-nmh -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)if ($ExtInstalled -and $NmhRunning) {    Write-Host "  [OK] Extension loaded + NMH connected -> browser_* events WILL be captured"} elseif ($ExtInstalled -and -not $NmhRunning) {    Write-Warning "  Extension installed but NMH (procmine-nmh.exe) not running. Check desktop agent is recording."} elseif (-not $ExtInstalled) {    Write-Warning "  Extension not found in profiles. Run one-time setup: open each portal in Chrome, go to chrome://extensions, Load unpacked -> $ExtPath"}# -- Run orchestrator -----------------------------------------------------Write-Host ""Write-Host "  Running orchestrator_m1.py  (Theme M1 - Mixed Multi-Domain)..."Write-Host "  -----------------------------------------------------------------"$OrchestratorPy = Join-Path $ScriptsDir "orchestrator_m1.py"Push-Location $ScriptsDir$exit_code = 0try {    $orchestrator_args = @(        $OrchestratorPy,        "--gt-run-id", "$RunId",        "--gt-log-dir", "$GtLogDir",        "--seed",  "$env:M1_SEED",        "--speed", "$env:M1_SPEED",        "--scale", "$env:M1_SCALE",        "--date",  "$env:M1_DATE"    )    & $PythonExe $orchestrator_args    $exit_code = $LASTEXITCODE} finally {    Pop-Location}# -- Audible done notification (recording runs unattended) ----------------try {    if ($exit_code -eq 0) {        [console]::beep(880, 250)        [console]::beep(1320, 350)    } else {        [console]::beep(440, 250)        [console]::beep(330, 400)    }} catch {}# -- Cleanup --------------------------------------------------------------Write-Host ""Write-Host "  Cleaning up all launched processes..."# Kill all Chrome and desktop app processes we launchedforeach ($proc in $launched_procs) {    try {        if (-not $proc.HasExited) {            Stop-Process -Id $proc.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue            Write-Host "    Killed PID $($proc.Id)"        }    } catch {}}# Kill http.server processes by port (in case -PassThru missed them)foreach ($port in @(5122, 5123, 5124)) {    $pids_raw = netstat -ano 2>$null | Select-String ":$port\s"    foreach ($line in $pids_raw) {        $p = ($line -split "\s+")[-1]        if ($p -match "^\d+$") {            try { Stop-Process -Id ([int]$p) -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } catch {}        }    }}Write-Host ""Write-Host "  Theme M1 complete."Write-Host "  GT log : $GtLogDir\$RunId.jsonl"Write-Host ""if ($exit_code -ne 0) { exit $exit_code }----------------------------------------SHIP-2026-3222 (佐川急便 → 北海道コーポレーション) — 追跡確認済。出荷完了処理。----------------------------------------傷病休暇申請を受理。期間: 2026-07-22 〜 USER INPUT  (prompt first, before any windows)# ============================================================================Write-Host ""Write-Host ("=" * 60)Write-Host "  Theme M1 - Run Setup"Write-Host ("=" * 60)# Seed — generate random if blank so orchestrator never re-promptsif (-not $env:M1_SEED) {    Write-Host "  [1] Seed - integer, blank for random" -NoNewline    $raw = Read-Host    if ($raw) { $env:M1_SEED = $raw } else { $env:M1_SEED = Get-Random -Min 100000 -Max 999999 }}Write-Host "  [1] Seed: $env:M1_SEED"# Speedif (-not $env:M1_SPEED) {    Write-Host "  [2] Speed - 1=fast 0.4x  2=normal 1.4x  [2]" -NoNewline    $raw = Read-Host    if ($raw) { $env:M1_SPEED = $raw } else { $env:M1_SPEED = "2" }}Write-Host "  [2] Speed: $env:M1_SPEED"# Scaleif (-not $env:M1_SCALE) {    Write-Host "  [3] Scale - 1=small 5-7  2=medium 8-10  3=large 11-14  [2]" -NoNewline    $raw = Read-Host    if ($raw) { $env:M1_SCALE = $raw } else { $env:M1_SCALE = "2" }}Write-Host "  [3] Scale: $env:M1_SCALE"# Dateif (-not $env:M1_DATE) {    Write-Host "  [4] Run date YYYY-MM-DD, blank=today" -NoNewline    $raw = Read-Host    if ($raw) { $env:M1_DATE = $raw } else { $env:M1_DATE = (Get-Date -Format "yyyy-MM-dd") }}Write-Host "  [4] Date: $env:M1_DATE"$env:PYTHONUTF8 = "1"Write-Host ""Write-Host "  Starting in 5 seconds. Press Ctrl-C to abort."Start-Sleep -Seconds 5# ============================================================================# 2. Infrastructure setup# ============================================================================Write-Host ""Write-Host "  Theme M1 - Launch Checklist"Write-Host "  -------------------------------------------------------"Write-Host "  Python : $PythonExe"Write-Host "  Chrome : $ChromeExe"& $PythonExe -c "import pyautogui, websocket" 2>&1 | Out-Nullif ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {    Write-Warning "Some packages missing. Run: pip install pyautogui websocket-client"} else {    Write-Host "  packages OK"}# -- GT log dir -----------------------------------------------------------$GtLogDir = Join-Path (Split-Path $ScriptDir -Parent) "gt-logs"New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $GtLogDir | Out-Null$RunId = "theme_m1_$(Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss')"Write-Host "  GT log : $GtLogDir\$RunId.jsonl"if (-not (Test-Path $DocsDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $DocsDir | Out-Null }$PdfCount = (Get-ChildItem $DocsDir -Filter "*.pdf" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Measure-Object).CountWrite-Host "  Docs   : $DocsDir ($PdfCount PDFs)"New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $TmpDir | Out-Null# -- Kill lingering http.server on our ports ------------------------------foreach ($port in @(5122, 5123, 5124)) {    $pids_raw = netstat -ano 2>$null | Select-String ":$port\s"    foreach ($line in $pids_raw) {        $p = ($line -split "\s+")[-1]        if ($p -match "^\d+$") {            try { Stop-Process -Id ([int]$p) -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } catch {}        }    }}# -- Launch everything in parallel -----------------------------------------$launch_ops = @()# http.server for each portalWrite-Host "  Starting Python http.server on ports 5122/5123/5124..."$server_defs = @(    @{port=5122; dir="hr-portal-jp"},    @{port=5123; dir="finance-portal-jp"},    @{port=5124; dir="ops-portal-jp"})foreach ($entry in $server_defs) {    $d = Join-Path $ToolsDir $entry.dir    $launch_ops += @{exe=$PythonExe; args=@("-m", "http.server", "$($entry.port)", "--directory", $d); label="http.server :$($entry.port)"; hidden=$true}}# Notepad$launch_ops += @{exe="notepad.exe"; args=@(); label="Notepad"}# Excelif ($ExcelExe -and (Test-Path $ExcelExe)) {    $xlsRef = Join-Path $ScriptDir "documents\m1_reference.xlsx"    if (Test-Path $xlsRef) {        $launch_ops += @{exe=$ExcelExe; args=@("`"$xlsRef`""); label="Excel (m1_reference.xlsx)"}    } else {        $launch_ops += @{exe=$ExcelExe; args=@(); label="Excel"}    }} else {    Write-Warning "  Excel not found - lookup steps will be skipped"}# Browser extension — loaded into scripted Chrome so browser_* / URL / DOM events# appear in raw UIA stream. Override with $env:M1_EXT_PATH if needed.$ExtPath = if ($env:M1_EXT_PATH) { $env:M1_EXT_PATH } else {    Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE "Downloads\procmine-extension-v1.0.0 (1)\procmine-extension"}if (Test-Path $ExtPath) {    Write-Host "  Browser extension: $ExtPath"    Write-Host "  -> browser_url_change / DOM events WILL appear in raw stream"} else {    Write-Warning "  Browser extension not found at: $ExtPath"    Write-Warning "  Set M1_EXT_PATH to override. Raw stream will lack URL route context."    $ExtPath = $null}# 3 Chrome portal windows$portals = @(    @{url="http://127.0.0.1:5122/"; cdp=9222; label="HR Portal";      dir="m1-hr"},    @{url="http://127.0.0.1:5123/"; cdp=9223; label="Finance Portal";  dir="m1-finance"},    @{url="http://127.0.0.1:5124/"; cdp=9224; label="Ops Portal";      dir="m1-ops"})foreach ($p in $portals) {    $udd = Join-Path $TmpDir $p.dir    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $udd | Out-Null    $chromeArgs = @(        "--remote-debugging-port=$($p.cdp)",        "--user-data-dir=$udd",        "--no-first-run",        "--no-default-browser-check",        "--disable-features=TranslateUI",        "--remote-allow-origins=*",        "--window-size=1280,900",        "--new-window",        $p.url    )    if ($ExtPath) { $chromeArgs += "--load-extension=$ExtPath" }    $launch_ops += @{exe=$ChromeExe; args=$chromeArgs; label="Chrome $($p.label)"}}# Fire everything in parallel; keep handles for cleanup$launched_procs = @()foreach ($op in $launch_ops) {    Write-Host "    Launching $($op.label)..."    $spArgs = @{FilePath=$op.exe; PassThru=$true}    if ($op.args.Count -gt 0) { $spArgs.ArgumentList = $op.args }    if ($op.hidden) { $spArgs.WindowStyle = "Hidden" }    $proc = Start-Process @spArgs    if ($proc) { $launched_procs += $proc }}Write-Host "  Waiting for all windows and portals to load..."Start-Sleep -Seconds 8# -- Extension check -------------------------------------------------------# Load Unpacked extensions are stored in Secure Preferences (not Extensions folder)$ExtId = "gfnbggcmaifligdcdiafmlbgpogheenn"$ExtInstalled = $falseforeach ($dir in @("m1-hr", "m1-finance", "m1-ops")) {    $secPref = Join-Path $TmpDir "$dir\Default\Secure Preferences"    if (Test-Path $secPref) {        $txt = Get-Content $secPref -Raw        if ($txt -match $ExtId) { $ExtInstalled = $true; break }    }}$NmhRunning = $null -ne (Get-Process procmine-nmh -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)if ($ExtInstalled -and $NmhRunning) {    Write-Host "  [OK] Extension loaded + NMH connected -> browser_* events WILL be captured"} elseif ($ExtInstalled -and -not $NmhRunning) {    Write-Warning "  Extension installed but NMH (procmine-nmh.exe) not running. Check desktop agent is recording."} elseif (-not $ExtInstalled) {    Write-Warning "  Extension not found in profiles. Run one-time setup: open each portal in Chrome, go to chrome://extensions, Load unpacked -> $ExtPath"}# -- Run orchestrator -----------------------------------------------------Write-Host ""Write-Host "  Running orchestrator_m1.py  (Theme M1 - Mixed Multi-Domain)..."Write-Host "  -----------------------------------------------------------------"$OrchestratorPy = Join-Path $ScriptsDir "orchestrator_m1.py"Push-Location $ScriptsDir$exit_code = 0try {    $orchestrator_args = @(        $OrchestratorPy,        "--gt-run-id", "$RunId",        "--gt-log-dir", "$GtLogDir",        "--seed",  "$env:M1_SEED",        "--speed", "$env:M1_SPEED",        "--scale", "$env:M1_SCALE",        "--date",  "$env:M1_DATE"    )    & $PythonExe $orchestrator_args    $exit_code = $LASTEXITCODE} finally {    Pop-Location}# -- Audible done notification (recording runs unattended) ----------------try {    if ($exit_code -eq 0) {        [console]::beep(880, 250)        [console]::beep(1320, 350)    } else {        [console]::beep(440, 250)        [console]::beep(330, 400)    }} catch {}# -- Cleanup --------------------------------------------------------------Write-Host ""Write-Host "  Cleaning up all launched processes..."# Kill all Chrome and desktop app processes we launchedforeach ($proc in $launched_procs) {    try {        if (-not $proc.HasExited) {            Stop-Process -Id $proc.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue            Write-Host "    Killed PID $($proc.Id)"        }    } catch {}}# Kill http.server processes by port (in case -PassThru missed them)foreach ($port in @(5122, 5123, 5124)) {    $pids_raw = netstat -ano 2>$null | Select-String ":$port\s"    foreach ($line in $pids_raw) {        $p = ($line -split "\s+")[-1]        if ($p -match "^\d+$") {            try { Stop-Process -Id ([int]$p) -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } catch {}        }    }}Write-Host ""Write-Host "  Theme M1 complete."Write-Host "  GT log : $GtLogDir\$RunId.jsonl"Write-Host ""if ($exit_code -ne 0) { exit $exit_code }----------------------------------------SHIP-2026-3222 (佐川急便 → 北海道コーポレーション) — 追跡確認済。出荷完了処理。----------------------------------------傷病休暇申請を受理。期間: 2026-07-22 〜 target_field.value: #Requires -Version 5.1<#.SYNOPSIS    Launch Theme M1 -- Mixed Multi-Domain Orchestrator    Asks for config first, then starts portals + desktop apps, then runs orchestrator..USAGE    cd <this-folder>    .\launch_m1.ps1.ENV OVERRIDES    Set before running to skip prompts:    $env:M1_SEED  = "42"    $env:M1_SPEED = "1"    # 1=fast(0.4x), 2=normal(1.4x)    $env:M1_SCALE = "1"    # 1=small(5-7), 2=medium(8-10), 3=large(11-14)    $env:M1_DATE  = "2026-06-29"#>Set-StrictMode -Off$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"# -- Paths ----------------------------------------------------------------$ScriptDir  = Split-Path -Parent $MyInvocation.MyCommand.Path$ToolsDir   = Join-Path $ScriptDir "tools"$ScriptsDir = Join-Path $ScriptDir "scripts"$DocsDir    = Join-Path $ScriptDir "documents"$TmpDir     = Join-Path (Split-Path $ScriptDir -Parent) "chrome-profiles"# -- Find executables -----------------------------------------------------function Find-Exe {    param([string[]]$Candidates, [string]$Name)    foreach ($c in $Candidates) {        if (Test-Path $c) { return $c }    }    $cmd = Get-Command $Name -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue    if ($cmd) { return $cmd.Source }    return $null}$PythonExe = Find-Exe @(    "C:\WINDOWS\py.exe",    "C:\Python314\python.exe",    "C:\Python312\python.exe",    "C:\Python311\python.exe",    "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Programs\Python\Python312\python.exe") "python"$ChromeExe = Find-Exe @(    "C:\Program Files\Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe",    "C:\Program Files (x86)\Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe") "chrome"$ExcelExe = Find-Exe @(    "C:\Program Files\Microsoft Office\root\Office16\EXCEL.EXE",    "C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft Office\root\Office16\EXCEL.EXE") "EXCEL"# -- Quick validation before prompting ------------------------------------if (-not $PythonExe) { Write-Error "Python not found."; exit 1 }if (-not $ChromeExe) { Write-Error "Chrome not found."; exit 1 }# ============================================================================# 1. USER INPUT  (prompt first, before any windows)# ============================================================================Write-Host ""Write-Host ("=" * 60)Write-Host "  Theme M1 - Run Setup"Write-Host ("=" * 60)# Seed — generate random if blank so orchestrator never re-promptsif (-not $env:M1_SEED) {    Write-Host "  [1] Seed - integer, blank for random" -NoNewline    $raw = Read-Host    if ($raw) { $env:M1_SEED = $raw } else { $env:M1_SEED = Get-Random -Min 100000 -Max 999999 }}Write-Host "  [1] Seed: $env:M1_SEED"# Speedif (-not $env:M1_SPEED) {    Write-Host "  [2] Speed - 1=fast 0.4x  2=normal 1.4x  [2]" -NoNewline    $raw = Read-Host    if ($raw) { $env:M1_SPEED = $raw } else { $env:M1_SPEED = "2" }}Write-Host "  [2] Speed: $env:M1_SPEED"# Scaleif (-not $env:M1_SCALE) {    Write-Host "  [3] Scale - 1=small 5-7  2=medium 8-10  3=large 11-14  [2]" -NoNewline    $raw = Read-Host    if ($raw) { $env:M1_SCALE = $raw } else { $env:M1_SCALE = "2" }}Write-Host "  [3] Scale: $env:M1_SCALE"# Dateif (-not $env:M1_DATE) {    Write-Host "  [4] Run date YYYY-MM-DD, blank=today" -NoNewline    $raw = Read-Host    if ($raw) { $env:M1_DATE = $raw } else { $env:M1_DATE = (Get-Date -Format "yyyy-MM-dd") }}Write-Host "  [4] Date: $env:M1_DATE"$env:PYTHONUTF8 = "1"Write-Host ""Write-Host "  Starting in 5 seconds. Press Ctrl-C to abort."Start-Sleep -Seconds 5# ============================================================================# 2. Infrastructure setup# ============================================================================Write-Host ""Write-Host "  Theme M1 - Launch Checklist"Write-Host "  -------------------------------------------------------"Write-Host "  Python : $PythonExe"Write-Host "  Chrome : $ChromeExe"& $PythonExe -c "import pyautogui, websocket" 2>&1 | Out-Nullif ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {    Write-Warning "Some packages missing. Run: pip install pyautogui websocket-client"} else {    Write-Host "  packages OK"}# -- GT log dir -----------------------------------------------------------$GtLogDir = Join-Path (Split-Path $ScriptDir -Parent) "gt-logs"New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $GtLogDir | Out-Null$RunId = "theme_m1_$(Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss')"Write-Host "  GT log : $GtLogDir\$RunId.jsonl"if (-not (Test-Path $DocsDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $DocsDir | Out-Null }$PdfCount = (Get-ChildItem $DocsDir -Filter "*.pdf" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Measure-Object).CountWrite-Host "  Docs   : $DocsDir ($PdfCount PDFs)"New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $TmpDir | Out-Null# -- Kill lingering http.server on our ports ------------------------------foreach ($port in @(5122, 5123, 5124)) {    $pids_raw = netstat -ano 2>$null | Select-String ":$port\s"    foreach ($line in $pids_raw) {        $p = ($line -split "\s+")[-1]        if ($p -match "^\d+$") {            try { Stop-Process -Id ([int]$p) -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } catch {}        }    }}# -- Launch everything in parallel -----------------------------------------$launch_ops = @()# http.server for each portalWrite-Host "  Starting Python http.server on ports 5122/5123/5124..."$server_defs = @(    @{port=5122; dir="hr-portal-jp"},    @{port=5123; dir="finance-portal-jp"},    @{port=5124; dir="ops-portal-jp"})foreach ($entry in $server_defs) {    $d = Join-Path $ToolsDir $entry.dir    $launch_ops += @{exe=$PythonExe; args=@("-m", "http.server", "$($entry.port)", "--directory", $d); label="http.server :$($entry.port)"; hidden=$true}}# Notepad$launch_ops += @{exe="notepad.exe"; args=@(); label="Notepad"}# Excelif ($ExcelExe -and (Test-Path $ExcelExe)) {    $xlsRef = Join-Path $ScriptDir "documents\m1_reference.xlsx"    if (Test-Path $xlsRef) {        $launch_ops += @{exe=$ExcelExe; args=@("`"$xlsRef`""); label="Excel (m1_reference.xlsx)"}    } else {        $launch_ops += @{exe=$ExcelExe; args=@(); label="Excel"}    }} else {    Write-Warning "  Excel not found - lookup steps will be skipped"}# Browser extension — loaded into scripted Chrome so browser_* / URL / DOM events# appear in raw UIA stream. Override with $env:M1_EXT_PATH if needed.$ExtPath = if ($env:M1_EXT_PATH) { $env:M1_EXT_PATH } else {    Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE "Downloads\procmine-extension-v1.0.0 (1)\procmine-extension"}if (Test-Path $ExtPath) {    Write-Host "  Browser extension: $ExtPath"    Write-Host "  -> browser_url_change / DOM events WILL appear in raw stream"} else {    Write-Warning "  Browser extension not found at: $ExtPath"    Write-Warning "  Set M1_EXT_PATH to override. Raw stream will lack URL route context."    $ExtPath = $null}# 3 Chrome portal windows$portals = @(    @{url="http://127.0.0.1:5122/"; cdp=9222; label="HR Portal";      dir="m1-hr"},    @{url="http://127.0.0.1:5123/"; cdp=9223; label="Finance Portal";  dir="m1-finance"},    @{url="http://127.0.0.1:5124/"; cdp=9224; label="Ops Portal";      dir="m1-ops"})foreach ($p in $portals) {    $udd = Join-Path $TmpDir $p.dir    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $udd | Out-Null    $chromeArgs = @(        "--remote-debugging-port=$($p.cdp)",        "--user-data-dir=$udd",        "--no-first-run",        "--no-default-browser-check",        "--disable-features=TranslateUI",        "--remote-allow-origins=*",        "--window-size=1280,900",        "--new-window",        $p.url    )    if ($ExtPath) { $chromeArgs += "--load-extension=$ExtPath" }    $launch_ops += @{exe=$ChromeExe; args=$chromeArgs; label="Chrome $($p.label)"}}# Fire everything in parallel; keep handles for cleanup$launched_procs = @()foreach ($op in $launch_ops) {    Write-Host "    Launching $($op.label)..."    $spArgs = @{FilePath=$op.exe; PassThru=$true}    if ($op.args.Count -gt 0) { $spArgs.ArgumentList = $op.args }    if ($op.hidden) { $spArgs.WindowStyle = "Hidden" }    $proc = Start-Process @spArgs    if ($proc) { $launched_procs += $proc }}Write-Host "  Waiting for all windows and portals to load..."Start-Sleep -Seconds 8# -- Extension check -------------------------------------------------------# Load Unpacked extensions are stored in Secure Preferences (not Extensions folder)$ExtId = "gfnbggcmaifligdcdiafmlbgpogheenn"$ExtInstalled = $falseforeach ($dir in @("m1-hr", "m1-finance", "m1-ops")) {    $secPref = Join-Path $TmpDir "$dir\Default\Secure Preferences"    if (Test-Path $secPref) {        $txt = Get-Content $secPref -Raw        if ($txt -match $ExtId) { $ExtInstalled = $true; break }    }}$NmhRunning = $null -ne (Get-Process procmine-nmh -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)if ($ExtInstalled -and $NmhRunning) {    Write-Host "  [OK] Extension loaded + NMH connected -> browser_* events WILL be captured"} elseif ($ExtInstalled -and -not $NmhRunning) {    Write-Warning "  Extension installed but NMH (procmine-nmh.exe) not running. Check desktop agent is recording."} elseif (-not $ExtInstalled) {    Write-Warning "  Extension not found in profiles. Run one-time setup: open each portal in Chrome, go to chrome://extensions, Load unpacked -> $ExtPath"}# -- Run orchestrator -----------------------------------------------------Write-Host ""Write-Host "  Running orchestrator_m1.py  (Theme M1 - Mixed Multi-Domain)..."Write-Host "  -----------------------------------------------------------------"$OrchestratorPy = Join-Path $ScriptsDir "orchestrator_m1.py"Push-Location $ScriptsDir$exit_code = 0try {    $orchestrator_args = @(        $OrchestratorPy,        "--gt-run-id", "$RunId",        "--gt-log-dir", "$GtLogDir",        "--seed",  "$env:M1_SEED",        "--speed", "$env:M1_SPEED",        "--scale", "$env:M1_SCALE",        "--date",  "$env:M1_DATE"    )    & $PythonExe $orchestrator_args    $exit_code = $LASTEXITCODE} finally {    Pop-Location}# -- Audible done notification (recording runs unattended) ----------------try {    if ($exit_code -eq 0) {        [console]::beep(880, 250)        [console]::beep(1320, 350)    } else {        [console]::beep(440, 250)        [console]::beep(330, 400)    }} catch {}# -- Cleanup --------------------------------------------------------------Write-Host ""Write-Host "  Cleaning up all launched processes..."# Kill all Chrome and desktop app processes we launchedforeach ($proc in $launched_procs) {    try {        if (-not $proc.HasExited) {            Stop-Process -Id $proc.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue            Write-Host "    Killed PID $($proc.Id)"        }    } catch {}}# Kill http.server processes by port (in case -PassThru missed them)foreach ($port in @(5122, 5123, 5124)) {    $pids_raw = netstat -ano 2>$null | Select-String ":$port\s"    foreach ($line in $pids_raw) {        $p = ($line -split "\s+")[-1]        if ($p -match "^\d+$") {            try { Stop-Process -Id ([int]$p) -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } catch {}        }    }}Write-Host ""Write-Host "  Theme M1 complete."Write-Host "  GT log : $GtLogDir\$RunId.jsonl"Write-Host ""if ($exit_code -ne 0) { exit $exit_code }----------------------------------------SHIP-2026-3222 (佐川急便 → 北海道コーポレーション) — 追跡確認済。出荷完了処理。----------------------------------------傷病休暇申請を受理。期間: 2026-07-22 〜 exit 1 }if (-not $ChromeExe) { Write-Error "Chrome not found."; exit 1 }# ============================================================================# 1. USER INPUT  (prompt first, before any windows)# ============================================================================Write-Host ""Write-Host ("=" * 60)Write-Host "  Theme M1 - Run Setup"Write-Host ("=" * 60)# Seed — generate random if blank so orchestrator never re-promptsif (-not $env:M1_SEED) {    Write-Host "  [1] Seed - integer, blank for random" -NoNewline    $raw = Read-Host    if ($raw) { $env:M1_SEED = $raw } else { $env:M1_SEED = Get-Random -Min 100000 -Max 999999 }}Write-Host "  [1] Seed: $env:M1_SEED"# Speedif (-not $env:M1_SPEED) {    Write-Host "  [2] Speed - 1=fast 0.4x  2=normal 1.4x  [2]" -NoNewline    $raw = Read-Host    if ($raw) { $env:M1_SPEED = $raw } else { $env:M1_SPEED = "2" }}Write-Host "  [2] Speed: $env:M1_SPEED"# Scaleif (-not $env:M1_SCALE) {    Write-Host "  [3] Scale - 1=small 5-7  2=medium 8-10  3=large 11-14  [2]" -NoNewline    $raw = Read-Host    if ($raw) { $env:M1_SCALE = $raw } else { $env:M1_SCALE = "2" }}Write-Host "  [3] Scale: $env:M1_SCALE"# Dateif (-not $env:M1_DATE) {    Write-Host "  [4] Run date YYYY-MM-DD, blank=today" -NoNewline    $raw = Read-Host    if ($raw) { $env:M1_DATE = $raw } else { $env:M1_DATE = (Get-Date -Format "yyyy-MM-dd") }}Write-Host "  [4] Date: $env:M1_DATE"$env:PYTHONUTF8 = "1"Write-Host ""Write-Host "  Starting in 5 seconds. Press Ctrl-C to abort."Start-Sleep -Seconds 5# ============================================================================# 2. Infrastructure setup# ============================================================================Write-Host ""Write-Host "  Theme M1 - Launch Checklist"Write-Host "  -------------------------------------------------------"Write-Host "  Python : $PythonExe"Write-Host "  Chrome : $ChromeExe"& $PythonExe -c "import pyautogui, websocket" 2>&1 | Out-Nullif ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {    Write-Warning "Some packages missing. Run: pip install pyautogui websocket-client"} else {    Write-Host "  packages OK"}# -- GT log dir -----------------------------------------------------------$GtLogDir = Join-Path (Split-Path $ScriptDir -Parent) "gt-logs"New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $GtLogDir | Out-Null$RunId = "theme_m1_$(Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss')"Write-Host "  GT log : $GtLogDir\$RunId.jsonl"if (-not (Test-Path $DocsDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $DocsDir | Out-Null }$PdfCount = (Get-ChildItem $DocsDir -Filter "*.pdf" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Measure-Object).CountWrite-Host "  Docs   : $DocsDir ($PdfCount PDFs)"New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $TmpDir | Out-Null# -- Kill lingering http.server on our ports ------------------------------foreach ($port in @(5122, 5123, 5124)) {    $pids_raw = netstat -ano 2>$null | Select-String ":$port\s"    foreach ($line in $pids_raw) {        $p = ($line -split "\s+")[-1]        if ($p -match "^\d+$") {            try { Stop-Process -Id ([int]$p) -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } catch {}        }    }}# -- Launch everything in parallel -----------------------------------------$launch_ops = @()# http.server for each portalWrite-Host "  Starting Python http.server on ports 5122/5123/5124..."$server_defs = @(    @{port=5122; dir="hr-portal-jp"},    @{port=5123; dir="finance-portal-jp"},    @{port=5124; dir="ops-portal-jp"})foreach ($entry in $server_defs) {    $d = Join-Path $ToolsDir $entry.dir    $launch_ops += @{exe=$PythonExe; args=@("-m", "http.server", "$($entry.port)", "--directory", $d); label="http.server :$($entry.port)"; hidden=$true}}# Notepad$launch_ops += @{exe="notepad.exe"; args=@(); label="Notepad"}# Excelif ($ExcelExe -and (Test-Path $ExcelExe)) {    $xlsRef = Join-Path $ScriptDir "documents\m1_reference.xlsx"    if (Test-Path $xlsRef) {        $launch_ops += @{exe=$ExcelExe; args=@("`"$xlsRef`""); label="Excel (m1_reference.xlsx)"}    } else {        $launch_ops += @{exe=$ExcelExe; args=@(); label="Excel"}    }} else {    Write-Warning "  Excel not found - lookup steps will be skipped"}# Browser extension — loaded into scripted Chrome so browser_* / URL / DOM events# appear in raw UIA stream. Override with $env:M1_EXT_PATH if needed.$ExtPath = if ($env:M1_EXT_PATH) { $env:M1_EXT_PATH } else {    Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE "Downloads\procmine-extension-v1.0.0 (1)\procmine-extension"}if (Test-Path $ExtPath) {    Write-Host "  Browser extension: $ExtPath"    Write-Host "  -> browser_url_change / DOM events WILL appear in raw stream"} else {    Write-Warning "  Browser extension not found at: $ExtPath"    Write-Warning "  Set M1_EXT_PATH to override. Raw stream will lack URL route context."    $ExtPath = $null}# 3 Chrome portal windows$portals = @(    @{url="http://127.0.0.1:5122/"; cdp=9222; label="HR Portal";      dir="m1-hr"},    @{url="http://127.0.0.1:5123/"; cdp=9223; label="Finance Portal";  dir="m1-finance"},    @{url="http://127.0.0.1:5124/"; cdp=9224; label="Ops Portal";      dir="m1-ops"})foreach ($p in $portals) {    $udd = Join-Path $TmpDir $p.dir    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $udd | Out-Null    $chromeArgs = @(        "--remote-debugging-port=$($p.cdp)",        "--user-data-dir=$udd",        "--no-first-run",        "--no-default-browser-check",        "--disable-features=TranslateUI",        "--remote-allow-origins=*",        "--window-size=1280,900",        "--new-window",        $p.url    )    if ($ExtPath) { $chromeArgs += "--load-extension=$ExtPath" }    $launch_ops += @{exe=$ChromeExe; args=$chromeArgs; label="Chrome $($p.label)"}}# Fire everything in parallel; keep handles for cleanup$launched_procs = @()foreach ($op in $launch_ops) {    Write-Host "    Launching $($op.label)..."    $spArgs = @{FilePath=$op.exe; PassThru=$true}    if ($op.args.Count -gt 0) { $spArgs.ArgumentList = $op.args }    if ($op.hidden) { $spArgs.WindowStyle = "Hidden" }    $proc = Start-Process @spArgs    if ($proc) { $launched_procs += $proc }}Write-Host "  Waiting for all windows and portals to load..."Start-Sleep -Seconds 8# -- Extension check -------------------------------------------------------# Load Unpacked extensions are stored in Secure Preferences (not Extensions folder)$ExtId = "gfnbggcmaifligdcdiafmlbgpogheenn"$ExtInstalled = $falseforeach ($dir in @("m1-hr", "m1-finance", "m1-ops")) {    $secPref = Join-Path $TmpDir "$dir\Default\Secure Preferences"    if (Test-Path $secPref) {        $txt = Get-Content $secPref -Raw        if ($txt -match $ExtId) { $ExtInstalled = $true; break }    }}$NmhRunning = $null -ne (Get-Process procmine-nmh -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)if ($ExtInstalled -and $NmhRunning) {    Write-Host "  [OK] Extension loaded + NMH connected -> browser_* events WILL be captured"} elseif ($ExtInstalled -and -not $NmhRunning) {    Write-Warning "  Extension installed but NMH (procmine-nmh.exe) not running. Check desktop agent is recording."} elseif (-not $ExtInstalled) {    Write-Warning "  Extension not found in profiles. Run one-time setup: open each portal in Chrome, go to chrome://extensions, Load unpacked -> $ExtPath"}# -- Run orchestrator -----------------------------------------------------Write-Host ""Write-Host "  Running orchestrator_m1.py  (Theme M1 - Mixed Multi-Domain)..."Write-Host "  -----------------------------------------------------------------"$OrchestratorPy = Join-Path $ScriptsDir "orchestrator_m1.py"Push-Location $ScriptsDir$exit_code = 0try {    $orchestrator_args = @(        $OrchestratorPy,        "--gt-run-id", "$RunId",        "--gt-log-dir", "$GtLogDir",        "--seed",  "$env:M1_SEED",        "--speed", "$env:M1_SPEED",        "--scale", "$env:M1_SCALE",        "--date",  "$env:M1_DATE"    )    & $PythonExe $orchestrator_args    $exit_code = $LASTEXITCODE} finally {    Pop-Location}# -- Audible done notification (recording runs unattended) ----------------try {    if ($exit_code -eq 0) {        [console]::beep(880, 250)        [console]::beep(1320, 350)    } else {        [console]::beep(440, 250)        [console]::beep(330, 400)    }} catch {}# -- Cleanup --------------------------------------------------------------Write-Host ""Write-Host "  Cleaning up all launched processes..."# Kill all Chrome and desktop app processes we launchedforeach ($proc in $launched_procs) {    try {        if (-not $proc.HasExited) {            Stop-Process -Id $proc.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue            Write-Host "    Killed PID $($proc.Id)"        }    } catch {}}# Kill http.server processes by port (in case -PassThru missed them)foreach ($port in @(5122, 5123, 5124)) {    $pids_raw = netstat -ano 2>$null | SilentlyContinue } catch {}        }    }}Write-Host ""Write-Host "  Theme M1 complete."Write-Host "  GT log : $GtLogDir\$RunId.jsonl"Write-Host ""if ($exit_code -ne 0) { exit $exit_code #Requires -Version 5.1<#.SYNOPSIS    Launch Theme M1 -- Mixed Multi-Domain Orchestrator    Asks for config first, then starts portals + desktop apps, then runs orchestrator..USAGE    cd <this-folder>    .\launch_m1.ps1.ENV OVERRIDES    Set before running to skip prompts:    $env:M1_SEED  = "42"    $env:M1_SPEED = "1"    # 1=fast(0.4x), 2=normal(1.4x)    $env:M1_SCALE = "1"    # 1=small(5-7), 2=medium(8-10), 3=large(11-14)    $env:M1_DATE  = "2026-06-29"#>Set-StrictMode -Off$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"# -- Paths ----------------------------------------------------------------$ScriptDir  = Split-Path -Parent $MyInvocation.MyCommand.Path$ToolsDir   = Join-Path $ScriptDir "tools"$ScriptsDir = Join-Path $ScriptDir "scripts"$DocsDir    = Join-Path $ScriptDir "documents"$TmpDir     = Join-Path (Split-Path $ScriptDir -Parent) "chrome-profiles"# -- Find executables -----------------------------------------------------function Find-Exe {    param([string[]]$Candidates, [string]$Name)    foreach ($c in $Candidates) {        if (Test-Path $c) { return $c }    }    $cmd = Get-Command $Name -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue    if ($cmd) { return $cmd.Source }    return $null}$PythonExe = Find-Exe @(    "C:\WINDOWS\py.exe",    "C:\Python314\python.exe",    "C:\Python312\python.exe",    "C:\Python311\python.exe",    "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Programs\Python\Python312\python.exe") "python"$ChromeExe = Find-Exe @(    "C:\Program Files\Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe",    "C:\Program Files (x86)\Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe") "chrome"$ExcelExe = Find-Exe @(    "C:\Program Files\Microsoft Office\root\Office16\EXCEL.EXE",    "C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft Office\root\Office16\EXCEL.EXE") "EXCEL"# -- Quick validation before prompting ------------------------------------if (-not $PythonExe) { Write-Error "Python not found."; exit 1 }if (-not $ChromeExe) { Write-Error "Chrome not found."; exit 1 }# ============================================================================# 1. USER INPUT  (prompt first, before any windows)# ============================================================================Write-Host ""Write-Host ("=" * 60)Write-Host "  Theme M1 - Run Setup"Write-Host ("=" * 60)# Seed — generate random if blank so orchestrator never re-promptsif (-not $env:M1_SEED) {    Write-Host "  [1] Seed - integer, blank for random" -NoNewline    $raw = Read-Host    if ($raw) { $env:M1_SEED = $raw } else { $env:M1_SEED = Get-Random -Min 100000 -Max 999999 }}Write-Host "  [1] Seed: $env:M1_SEED"# Speedif (-not $env:M1_SPEED) {    Write-Host "  [2] Speed - 1=fast 0.4x  2=normal 1.4x  [2]" -NoNewline    $raw = Read-Host    if ($raw) { $env:M1_SPEED = $raw } else { $env:M1_SPEED = "2" }}Write-Host "  [2] Speed: $env:M1_SPEED"# Scaleif (-not $env:M1_SCALE) {    Write-Host "  [3] Scale - 1=small 5-7  2=medium 8-10  3=large 11-14  [2]" -NoNewline    $raw = Read-Host    if ($raw) { $env:M1_SCALE = $raw } else { $env:M1_SCALE = "2" }}Write-Host "  [3] Scale: $env:M1_SCALE"# Dateif (-not $env:M1_DATE) {    Write-Host "  [4] Run date YYYY-MM-DD, blank=today" -NoNewline    $raw = Read-Host    if ($raw) { $env:M1_DATE = $raw } else { $env:M1_DATE = (Get-Date -Format "yyyy-MM-dd") }}Write-Host "  [4] Date: $env:M1_DATE"$env:PYTHONUTF8 = "1"Write-Host ""Write-Host "  Starting in 5 seconds. Press Ctrl-C to abort."Start-Sleep -Seconds 5# ============================================================================# 2. Infrastructure setup# ============================================================================Write-Host ""Write-Host "  Theme M1 - Launch Checklist"Write-Host "  -------------------------------------------------------"Write-Host "  Python : $PythonExe"Write-Host "  Chrome : $ChromeExe"& $PythonExe -c "import pyautogui, websocket" 2>&1 | Out-Nullif ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {    Write-Warning "Some packages missing. Run: pip install pyautogui websocket-client"} else {    Write-Host "  packages OK"}# -- GT log dir -----------------------------------------------------------$GtLogDir = Join-Path (Split-Path $ScriptDir -Parent) "gt-logs"New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $GtLogDir | Out-Null$RunId = "theme_m1_$(Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss')"Write-Host "  GT log : $GtLogDir\$RunId.jsonl"if (-not (Test-Path $DocsDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $DocsDir | Out-Null }$PdfCount = (Get-ChildItem $DocsDir -Filter "*.pdf" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Measure-Object).CountWrite-Host "  Docs   : $DocsDir ($PdfCount PDFs)"New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $TmpDir | Out-Null# -- Kill lingering http.server on our ports ------------------------------foreach ($port in @(5122, 5123, 5124)) {    $pids_raw = netstat -ano 2>$null | Select-String ":$port\s"    foreach ($line in $pids_raw) {        $p = ($line -split "\s+")[-1]        if ($p -match "^\d+$") {            try { Stop-Process -Id ([int]$p) -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } catch {}        }    }}# -- Launch everything in parallel -----------------------------------------$launch_ops = @()# http.server for each portalWrite-Host "  Starting Python http.server on ports 5122/5123/5124..."$server_defs = @(    @{port=5122; dir="hr-portal-jp"},    @{port=5123; dir="finance-portal-jp"},    @{port=5124; dir="ops-portal-jp"})foreach ($entry in $server_defs) {    $d = Join-Path $ToolsDir $entry.dir    $launch_ops += @{exe=$PythonExe; args=@("-m", "http.server", "$($entry.port)", "--directory", $d); label="http.server :$($entry.port)"; hidden=$true}}# Notepad$launch_ops += @{exe="notepad.exe"; args=@(); label="Notepad"}# Excelif ($ExcelExe -and (Test-Path $ExcelExe)) {    $xlsRef = Join-Path $ScriptDir "documents\m1_reference.xlsx"    if (Test-Path $xlsRef) {        $launch_ops += @{exe=$ExcelExe; args=@("`"$xlsRef`""); label="Excel (m1_reference.xlsx)"}    } else {        $launch_ops += @{exe=$ExcelExe; args=@(); label="Excel"}    }} else {    Write-Warning "  Excel not found - lookup steps will be skipped"}# Browser extension — loaded into scripted Chrome so browser_* / URL / DOM events# appear in raw UIA stream. Override with $env:M1_EXT_PATH if needed.$ExtPath = if ($env:M1_EXT_PATH) { $env:M1_EXT_PATH } else {    Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE "Downloads\procmine-extension-v1.0.0 (1)\procmine-extension"}if (Test-Path $ExtPath) {    Write-Host "  Browser extension: $ExtPath"    Write-Host "  -> browser_url_change / DOM events WILL appear in raw stream"} else {    Write-Warning "  Browser extension not found at: $ExtPath"    Write-Warning "  Set M1_EXT_PATH to override. Raw stream will lack URL route context."    $ExtPath = $null}# 3 Chrome portal windows$portals = @(    @{url="http://127.0.0.1:5122/"; cdp=9222; label="HR Portal";      dir="m1-hr"},    @{url="http://127.0.0.1:5123/"; cdp=9223; label="Finance Portal";  dir="m1-finance"},    @{url="http://127.0.0.1:5124/"; cdp=9224; label="Ops Portal";      dir="m1-ops"})foreach ($p in $portals) {    $udd = Join-Path $TmpDir $p.dir    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $udd | Out-Null    $chromeArgs = @(        "--remote-debugging-port=$($p.cdp)",        "--user-data-dir=$udd",        "--no-first-run",        "--no-default-browser-check",        "--disable-features=TranslateUI",        "--remote-allow-origins=*",        "--window-size=1280,900",        "--new-window",        $p.url    )    if ($ExtPath) { $chromeArgs += "--load-extension=$ExtPath" }    $launch_ops += @{exe=$ChromeExe; args=$chromeArgs; label="Chrome $($p.label)"}}# Fire everything in parallel; keep handles for cleanup$launched_procs = @()foreach ($op in $launch_ops) {    Write-Host "    Launching $($op.label)..."    $spArgs = @{FilePath=$op.exe; PassThru=$true}    if ($op.args.Count -gt 0) { $spArgs.ArgumentList = $op.args }    if ($op.hidden) { $spArgs.WindowStyle = "Hidden" }    $proc = Start-Process @spArgs    if ($proc) { $launched_procs += $proc }}Write-Host "  Waiting for all windows and portals to load..."Start-Sleep -Seconds 8# -- Extension check -------------------------------------------------------# Load Unpacked extensions are stored in Secure Preferences (not Extensions folder)$ExtId = "gfnbggcmaifligdcdiafmlbgpogheenn"$ExtInstalled = $falseforeach ($dir in @("m1-hr", "m1-finance", "m1-ops")) {    $secPref = Join-Path $TmpDir "$dir\Default\Secure Preferences"    if (Test-Path $secPref) {        $txt = Get-Content $secPref -Raw        if ($txt -match $ExtId) { $ExtInstalled = $true; break }    }}$NmhRunning = $null -ne (Get-Process procmine-nmh -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)if ($ExtInstalled -and $NmhRunning) {    Write-Host "  [OK] Extension loaded + NMH connected -> browser_* events WILL be captured"} elseif ($ExtInstalled -and -not $NmhRunning) {    Write-Warning "  Extension installed but NMH (procmine-nmh.exe) not running. Check desktop agent is recording."} elseif (-not $ExtInstalled) {    Write-Warning "  Extension not found in profiles. Run one-time setup: open each portal in Chrome, go to chrome://extensions, Load unpacked -> $ExtPath"}# -- Run orchestrator -----------------------------------------------------Write-Host ""Write-Host "  Running orchestrator_m1.py  (Theme M1 - Mixed Multi-Domain)..."Write-Host "  -----------------------------------------------------------------"$OrchestratorPy = Join-Path $ScriptsDir "orchestrator_m1.py"Push-Location $ScriptsDir$exit_code = 0try {    $orchestrator_args = @(        $OrchestratorPy,        "--gt-run-id", "$RunId",        "--gt-log-dir", "$GtLogDir",        "--seed",  "$env:M1_SEED",        "--speed", "$env:M1_SPEED",        "--scale", "$env:M1_SCALE",        "--date",  "$env:M1_DATE"    )    & $PythonExe $orchestrator_args    $exit_code = $LASTEXITCODE} finally {    Pop-Location}# -- Audible done notification (recording runs unattended) ----------------try {    if ($exit_code -eq 0) {        [console]::beep(880, 250)        [console]::beep(1320, 350)    } else {        [console]::beep(440, 250)        [console]::beep(330, 400)    }} catch {}# -- Cleanup --------------------------------------------------------------Write-Host ""Write-Host "  Cleaning up all launched processes..."# Kill all Chrome and desktop app processes we launchedforeach ($proc in $launched_procs) {    try {        if (-not $proc.HasExited) {            Stop-Process -Id $proc.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue            Write-Host "    Killed PID $($proc.Id)"        }    } catch {}}# Kill http.server processes by port (in case -PassThru missed them)foreach ($port in @(5122, 5123, 5124)) {    $pids_raw = netstat -ano 2>$null | Select-String ":$port\s"    foreach ($line in $pids_raw) {        $p = ($line -split "\s+")[-1]        if ($p -match "^\d+$") {            try { Stop-Process -Id ([int]$p) -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } catch {}        }    }}Write-Host ""Write-Host "  Theme M1 complete."Write-Host "  GT log : $GtLogDir\$RunId.jsonl"Write-Host ""if ($exit_code -ne 0) { exit $exit_code }----------------------------------------SHIP-2026-3222 (佐川急便 → 北海道コーポレーション) — 追跡確認済。出荷完了処理。----------------------------------------傷病休暇申請を受理。期間: 2026-07-22 〜 USER INPUT  (prompt first, before any windows)# ============================================================================Write-Host ""Write-Host ("=" * 60)Write-Host "  Theme M1 - Run Setup"Write-Host ("=" * 60)# Seed — generate random if blank so orchestrator never re-promptsif (-not $env:M1_SEED) {    Write-Host "  [1] Seed - integer, blank for random" -NoNewline    $raw = Read-Host    if ($raw) { $env:M1_SEED = $raw } else { $env:M1_SEED = Get-Random -Min 100000 -Max 999999 }}Write-Host "  [1] Seed: $env:M1_SEED"# Speedif (-not $env:M1_SPEED) {    Write-Host "  [2] Speed - 1=fast 0.4x  2=normal 1.4x  [2]" -NoNewline    $raw = Read-Host    if ($raw) { $env:M1_SPEED = $raw } else { $env:M1_SPEED = "2" }}Write-Host "  [2] Speed: $env:M1_SPEED"# Scaleif (-not $env:M1_SCALE) {    Write-Host "  [3] Scale - 1=small 5-7  2=medium 8-10  3=large 11-14  [2]" -NoNewline    $raw = Read-Host    if ($raw) { $env:M1_SCALE = $raw } else { $env:M1_SCALE = "2" }}Write-Host "  [3] Scale: $env:M1_SCALE"# Dateif (-not $env:M1_DATE) {    Write-Host "  [4] Run date YYYY-MM-DD, blank=today" -NoNewline    $raw = Read-Host    if ($raw) { $env:M1_DATE = $raw } else { $env:M1_DATE = (Get-Date -Format "yyyy-MM-dd") }}Write-Host "  [4] Date: $env:M1_DATE"$env:PYTHONUTF8 = "1"Write-Host ""Write-Host "  Starting in 5 seconds. Press Ctrl-C to abort."Start-Sleep -Seconds 5# ============================================================================# 2. Infrastructure setup# ============================================================================Write-Host ""Write-Host "  Theme M1 - Launch Checklist"Write-Host "  -------------------------------------------------------"Write-Host "  Python : $PythonExe"Write-Host "  Chrome : $ChromeExe"& $PythonExe -c "import pyautogui, websocket" 2>&1 | Out-Nullif ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {    Write-Warning "Some packages missing. Run: pip install pyautogui websocket-client"} else {    Write-Host "  packages OK"}# -- GT log dir -----------------------------------------------------------$GtLogDir = Join-Path (Split-Path $ScriptDir -Parent) "gt-logs"New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $GtLogDir | Out-Null$RunId = "theme_m1_$(Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss')"Write-Host "  GT log : $GtLogDir\$RunId.jsonl"if (-not (Test-Path $DocsDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $DocsDir | Out-Null }$PdfCount = (Get-ChildItem $DocsDir -Filter "*.pdf" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Measure-Object).CountWrite-Host "  Docs   : $DocsDir ($PdfCount PDFs)"New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $TmpDir | Out-Null# -- Kill lingering http.server on our ports ------------------------------foreach ($port in @(5122, 5123, 5124)) {    $pids_raw = netstat -ano 2>$null | Select-String ":$port\s"    foreach ($line in $pids_raw) {        $p = ($line -split "\s+")[-1]        if ($p -match "^\d+$") {            try { Stop-Process -Id ([int]$p) -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } catch {}        }    }}# -- Launch everything in parallel -----------------------------------------$launch_ops = @()# http.server for each portalWrite-Host "  Starting Python http.server on ports 5122/5123/5124..."$server_defs = @(    @{port=5122; dir="hr-portal-jp"},    @{port=5123; dir="finance-portal-jp"},    @{port=5124; dir="ops-portal-jp"})foreach ($entry in $server_defs) {    $d = Join-Path $ToolsDir $entry.dir    $launch_ops += @{exe=$PythonExe; args=@("-m", "http.server", "$($entry.port)", "--directory", $d); label="http.server :$($entry.port)"; hidden=$true}}# Notepad$launch_ops += @{exe="notepad.exe"; args=@(); label="Notepad"}# Excelif ($ExcelExe -and (Test-Path $ExcelExe)) {    $xlsRef = Join-Path $ScriptDir "documents\m1_reference.xlsx"    if (Test-Path $xlsRef) {        $launch_ops += @{exe=$ExcelExe; args=@("`"$xlsRef`""); label="Excel (m1_reference.xlsx)"}    } else {        $launch_ops += @{exe=$ExcelExe; args=@(); label="Excel"}    }} else {    Write-Warning "  Excel not found - lookup steps will be skipped"}# Browser extension — loaded into scripted Chrome so browser_* / URL / DOM events# appear in raw UIA stream. Override with $env:M1_EXT_PATH if needed.$ExtPath = if ($env:M1_EXT_PATH) { $env:M1_EXT_PATH } else {    Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE "Downloads\procmine-extension-v1.0.0 (1)\procmine-extension"}if (Test-Path $ExtPath) {    Write-Host "  Browser extension: $ExtPath"    Write-Host "  -> browser_url_change / DOM events WILL appear in raw stream"} else {    Write-Warning "  Browser extension not found at: $ExtPath"    Write-Warning "  Set M1_EXT_PATH to override. Raw stream will lack URL route context."    $ExtPath = $null}# 3 Chrome portal windows$portals = @(    @{url="http://127.0.0.1:5122/"; cdp=9222; label="HR Portal";      dir="m1-hr"},    @{url="http://127.0.0.1:5123/"; cdp=9223; label="Finance Portal";  dir="m1-finance"},    @{url="http://127.0.0.1:5124/"; cdp=9224; label="Ops Portal";      dir="m1-ops"})foreach ($p in $portals) {    $udd = Join-Path $TmpDir $p.dir    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $udd | Out-Null    $chromeArgs = @(        "--remote-debugging-port=$($p.cdp)",        "--user-data-dir=$udd",        "--no-first-run",        "--no-default-browser-check",        "--disable-features=TranslateUI",        "--remote-allow-origins=*",        "--window-size=1280,900",        "--new-window",        $p.url    )    if ($ExtPath) { $chromeArgs += "--load-extension=$ExtPath" }    $launch_ops += @{exe=$ChromeExe; args=$chromeArgs; label="Chrome $($p.label)"}}# Fire everything in parallel; keep handles for cleanup$launched_procs = @()foreach ($op in $launch_ops) {    Write-Host "    Launching $($op.label)..."    $spArgs = @{FilePath=$op.exe; PassThru=$true}    if ($op.args.Count -gt 0) { $spArgs.ArgumentList = $op.args }    if ($op.hidden) { $spArgs.WindowStyle = "Hidden" }    $proc = Start-Process @spArgs    if ($proc) { $launched_procs += $proc }}Write-Host "  Waiting for all windows and portals to load..."Start-Sleep -Seconds 8# -- Extension check -------------------------------------------------------# Load Unpacked extensions are stored in Secure Preferences (not Extensions folder)$ExtId = "gfnbggcmaifligdcdiafmlbgpogheenn"$ExtInstalled = $falseforeach ($dir in @("m1-hr", "m1-finance", "m1-ops")) {    $secPref = Join-Path $TmpDir "$dir\Default\Secure Preferences"    if (Test-Path $secPref) {        $txt = Get-Content $secPref -Raw        if ($txt -match $ExtId) { $ExtInstalled = $true; break }    }}$NmhRunning = $null -ne (Get-Process procmine-nmh -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)if ($ExtInstalled -and $NmhRunning) {    Write-Host "  [OK] Extension loaded + NMH connected -> browser_* events WILL be captured"} elseif ($ExtInstalled -and -not $NmhRunning) {    Write-Warning "  Extension installed but NMH (procmine-nmh.exe) not running. Check desktop agent is recording."} elseif (-not $ExtInstalled) {    Write-Warning "  Extension not found in profiles. Run one-time setup: open each portal in Chrome, go to chrome://extensions, Load unpacked -> $ExtPath"}# -- Run orchestrator -----------------------------------------------------Write-Host ""Write-Host "  Running orchestrator_m1.py  (Theme M1 - Mixed Multi-Domain)..."Write-Host "  -----------------------------------------------------------------"$OrchestratorPy = Join-Path $ScriptsDir "orchestrator_m1.py"Push-Location $ScriptsDir$exit_code = 0try {    $orchestrator_args = @(        $OrchestratorPy,        "--gt-run-id", "$RunId",        "--gt-log-dir", "$GtLogDir",        "--seed",  "$env:M1_SEED",        "--speed", "$env:M1_SPEED",        "--scale", "$env:M1_SCALE",        "--date",  "$env:M1_DATE"    )    & $PythonExe $orchestrator_args    $exit_code = $LASTEXITCODE} finally {    Pop-Location}# -- Audible done notification (recording runs unattended) ----------------try {    if ($exit_code -eq 0) {        [console]::beep(880, 250)        [console]::beep(1320, 350)    } else {        [console]::beep(440, 250)        [console]::beep(330, 400)    }} catch {}# -- Cleanup --------------------------------------------------------------Write-Host ""Write-Host "  Cleaning up all launched processes..."# Kill all Chrome and desktop app processes we launchedforeach ($proc in $launched_procs) {    try {        if (-not $proc.HasExited) {            Stop-Process -Id $proc.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue            Write-Host "    Killed PID $($proc.Id)"        }    } catch {}}# Kill http.server processes by port (in case -PassThru missed them)foreach ($port in @(5122, 5123, 5124)) {    $pids_raw = netstat -ano 2>$null | Select-String ":$port\s"    foreach ($line in $pids_raw) {        $p = ($line -split "\s+")[-1]        if ($p -match "^\d+$") {            try { Stop-Process -Id ([int]$p) -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } catch {}        }    }}Write-Host ""Write-Host "  Theme M1 complete."Write-Host "  GT log : $GtLogDir\$RunId.jsonl"Write-Host ""if ($exit_code -ne 0) { exit $exit_code }----------------------------------------SHIP-2026-3222 (佐川急便 → 北海道コーポレーション) — 追跡確認済。出荷完了処理。----------------------------------------傷病休暇申請を受理。期間: 2026-07-22 〜 exit 1 }if (-not $ChromeExe) { Write-Error "Chrome not found."; exit 1 }# ============================================================================# 1. USER INPUT  (prompt first, before any windows)# ============================================================================Write-Host ""Write-Host ("=" * 60)Write-Host "  Theme M1 - Run Setup"Write-Host ("=" * 60)# Seed — generate random if blank so orchestrator never re-promptsif (-not $env:M1_SEED) {    Write-Host "  [1] Seed - integer, blank for random" -NoNewline    $raw = Read-Host    if ($raw) { $env:M1_SEED = $raw } else { $env:M1_SEED = Get-Random -Min 100000 -Max 999999 }}Write-Host "  [1] Seed: $env:M1_SEED"# Speedif (-not $env:M1_SPEED) {    Write-Host "  [2] Speed - 1=fast 0.4x  2=normal 1.4x  [2]" -NoNewline    $raw = Read-Host    if ($raw) { $env:M1_SPEED = $raw } else { $env:M1_SPEED = "2" }}Write-Host "  [2] Speed: $env:M1_SPEED"# Scaleif (-not $env:M1_SCALE) {    Write-Host "  [3] Scale - 1=small 5-7  2=medium 8-10  3=large 11-14  [2]" -NoNewline    $raw = Read-Host    if ($raw) { $env:M1_SCALE = $raw } else { $env:M1_SCALE = "2" }}Write-Host "  [3] Scale: $env:M1_SCALE"# Dateif (-not $env:M1_DATE) {    Write-Host "  [4] Run date YYYY-MM-DD, blank=today" -NoNewline    $raw = Read-Host    if ($raw) { $env:M1_DATE = $raw } else { $env:M1_DATE = (Get-Date -Format "yyyy-MM-dd") }}Write-Host "  [4] Date: $env:M1_DATE"$env:PYTHONUTF8 = "1"Write-Host ""Write-Host "  Starting in 5 seconds. Press Ctrl-C to abort."Start-Sleep -Seconds 5# ============================================================================# 2. Infrastructure setup# ============================================================================Write-Host ""Write-Host "  Theme M1 - Launch Checklist"Write-Host "  -------------------------------------------------------"Write-Host "  Python : $PythonExe"Write-Host "  Chrome : $ChromeExe"& $PythonExe -c "import pyautogui, websocket" 2>&1 | Out-Nullif ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {    Write-Warning "Some packages missing. Run: pip install pyautogui websocket-client"} else {    Write-Host "  packages OK"}# -- GT log dir -----------------------------------------------------------$GtLogDir = Join-Path (Split-Path $ScriptDir -Parent) "gt-logs"New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $GtLogDir | Out-Null$RunId = "theme_m1_$(Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss')"Write-Host "  GT log : $GtLogDir\$RunId.jsonl"if (-not (Test-Path $DocsDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $DocsDir | Out-Null }$PdfCount = (Get-ChildItem $DocsDir -Filter "*.pdf" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Measure-Object).CountWrite-Host "  Docs   : $DocsDir ($PdfCount PDFs)"New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $TmpDir | Out-Null# -- Kill lingering http.server on our ports ------------------------------foreach ($port in @(5122, 5123, 5124)) {    $pids_raw = netstat -ano 2>$null | Select-String ":$port\s"    foreach ($line in $pids_raw) {        $p = ($line -split "\s+")[-1]        if ($p -match "^\d+$") {            try { Stop-Process -Id ([int]$p) -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } catch {}        }    }}# -- Launch everything in parallel -----------------------------------------$launch_ops = @()# http.server for each portalWrite-Host "  Starting Python http.server on ports 5122/5123/5124..."$server_defs = @(    @{port=5122; dir="hr-portal-jp"},    @{port=5123; dir="finance-portal-jp"},    @{port=5124; dir="ops-portal-jp"})foreach ($entry in $server_defs) {    $d = Join-Path $ToolsDir $entry.dir    $launch_ops += @{exe=$PythonExe; args=@("-m", "http.server", "$($entry.port)", "--directory", $d); label="http.server :$($entry.port)"; hidden=$true}}# Notepad$launch_ops += @{exe="notepad.exe"; args=@(); label="Notepad"}# Excelif ($ExcelExe -and (Test-Path $ExcelExe)) {    $xlsRef = Join-Path $ScriptDir "documents\m1_reference.xlsx"    if (Test-Path $xlsRef) {        $launch_ops += @{exe=$ExcelExe; args=@("`"$xlsRef`""); label="Excel (m1_reference.xlsx)"}    } else {        $launch_ops += @{exe=$ExcelExe; args=@(); label="Excel"}    }} else {    Write-Warning "  Excel not found - lookup steps will be skipped"}# Browser extension — loaded into scripted Chrome so browser_* / URL / DOM events# appear in raw UIA stream. Override with $env:M1_EXT_PATH if needed.$ExtPath = if ($env:M1_EXT_PATH) { $env:M1_EXT_PATH } else {    Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE "Downloads\procmine-extension-v1.0.0 (1)\procmine-extension"}if (Test-Path $ExtPath) {    Write-Host "  Browser extension: $ExtPath"    Write-Host "  -> browser_url_change / DOM events WILL appear in raw stream"} else {    Write-Warning "  Browser extension not found at: $ExtPath"    Write-Warning "  Set M1_EXT_PATH to override. Raw stream will lack URL route context."    $ExtPath = $null}# 3 Chrome portal windows$portals = @(    @{url="http://127.0.0.1:5122/"; cdp=9222; label="HR Portal";      dir="m1-hr"},    @{url="http://127.0.0.1:5123/"; cdp=9223; label="Finance Portal";  dir="m1-finance"},    @{url="http://127.0.0.1:5124/"; cdp=9224; label="Ops Portal";      dir="m1-ops"})foreach ($p in $portals) {    $udd = Join-Path $TmpDir $p.dir    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $udd | Out-Null    $chromeArgs = @(        "--remote-debugging-port=$($p.cdp)",        "--user-data-dir=$udd",        "--no-first-run",        "--no-default-browser-check",        "--disable-features=TranslateUI",        "--remote-allow-origins=*",        "--window-size=1280,900",        "--new-window",        $p.url    )    if ($ExtPath) { $chromeArgs += "--load-extension=$ExtPath" }    $launch_ops += @{exe=$ChromeExe; args=$chromeArgs; label="Chrome $($p.label)"}}# Fire everything in parallel; keep handles for cleanup$launched_procs = @()foreach ($op in $launch_ops) {    Write-Host "    Launching $($op.label)..."    $spArgs = @{FilePath=$op.exe; PassThru=$true}    if ($op.args.Count -gt 0) { $spArgs.ArgumentList = $op.args }    if ($op.hidden) { $spArgs.WindowStyle = "Hidden" }    $proc = Start-Process @spArgs    if ($proc) { $launched_procs += $proc }}Write-Host "  Waiting for all windows and portals to load..."Start-Sleep -Seconds 8# -- Extension check -------------------------------------------------------# Load Unpacked extensions are stored in Secure Preferences (not Extensions folder)$ExtId = "gfnbggcmaifligdcdiafmlbgpogheenn"$ExtInstalled = $falseforeach ($dir in @("m1-hr", "m1-finance", "m1-ops")) {    $secPref = Join-Path $TmpDir "$dir\Default\Secure Preferences"    if (Test-Path $secPref) {        $txt = Get-Content $secPref -Raw        if ($txt -match $ExtId) { $ExtInstalled = $true; break }    }}$NmhRunning = $null -ne (Get-Process procmine-nmh -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)if ($ExtInstalled -and $NmhRunning) {    Write-Host "  [OK] Extension loaded + NMH connected -> browser_* events WILL be captured"} elseif ($ExtInstalled -and -not $NmhRunning) {    Write-Warning "  Extension installed but NMH (procmine-nmh.exe) not running. Check desktop agent is recording."} elseif (-not $ExtInstalled) {    Write-Warning "  Extension not found in profiles. Run one-time setup: open each portal in Chrome, go to chrome://extensions, Load unpacked -> $ExtPath"}# -- Run orchestrator -----------------------------------------------------Write-Host ""Write-Host "  Running orchestrator_m1.py  (Theme M1 - Mixed Multi-Domain)..."Write-Host "  -----------------------------------------------------------------"$OrchestratorPy = Join-Path $ScriptsDir "orchestrator_m1.py"Push-Location $ScriptsDir$exit_code = 0try {    $orchestrator_args = @(        $OrchestratorPy,        "--gt-run-id", "$RunId",        "--gt-log-dir", "$GtLogDir",        "--seed",  "$env:M1_SEED",        "--speed", "$env:M1_SPEED",        "--scale", "$env:M1_SCALE",        "--date",  "$env:M1_DATE"    )    & $PythonExe $orchestrator_args    $exit_code = $LASTEXITCODE} finally {    Pop-Location}# -- Audible done notification (recording runs unattended) ----------------try {    if ($exit_code -eq 0) {        [console]::beep(880, 250)        [console]::beep(1320, 350)    } else {        [console]::beep(440, 250)        [console]::beep(330, 400)    }} catch {}# -- Cleanup --------------------------------------------------------------Write-Host ""Write-Host "  Cleaning up all launched processes..."# Kill all Chrome and desktop app processes we launchedforeach ($proc in $launched_procs) {    try {        if (-not $proc.HasExited) {            Stop-Process -Id $proc.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue            Write-Host "    Killed PID $($proc.Id)"        }    } catch {}}# Kill http.server processes by port (in case -PassThru missed them)foreach ($port in @(5122, 5123, 5124)) {    $pids_raw = netstat -ano 2>$null | Select-String ":$port\s"    foreach ($line in $pids_raw) {        $p = ($line -split "\s+")[-1]        if ($p -match "^\d+$") {            try { Stop-Process -Id ([int]$p) -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } catch {}        }    }}Write-Host ""Write-Host "  Theme M1 complete."Write-Host "  GT log : $GtLogDir\$RunId.jsonl"Write-Host ""if ($exit_code -ne 0) { exit $exit_code }----------------------------------------SHIP-2026-3222 (佐川急便 → 北海道コーポレーション) — 追跡確認済。出荷完了処理。----------------------------------------傷病休暇申請を受理。期間: 2026-07-22 〜
